mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,task_id,seq,record_version,event_version,fact_key,type,occurred_at,event_snapshot,event_digest,event_bytes,source_digest,source_step_id,source_invocation_id,committed_attempt_id,committed_fence,reliable_event_seq,content_state FROM session_public_event FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{session} AND seq BETWEEN 0 AND #{upper} AND event_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 16384 AND OCTET_LENGTH(event_snapshot)=event_bytes ORDER BY seq LIMIT 128
